definitions.explanation: The process of converting waste materials into new products or resources.

examples.japanese: ペットボトルをリサイクルに{出|だ}す。
examples.english: I put out plastic bottles for recycling.

examples.japanese: リサイクルできる{素材|そざい}を{使|つか}う{製品|せいひん}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Products using recyclable materials are increasing.

examples.japanese: この{市|し}はリサイクル{率|りつ}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: This city has a high recycling rate.

notes:
リサイクル is a loanword from English "recycle."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- リサイクルに{出|だ}す - to put out for recycling
- リサイクル{可能|かのう} - recyclable
- リサイクル{率|りつ} - recycling rate
- リサイクル{品|ひん} - recycled goods
- リサイクルショップ - secondhand shop, thrift store

SURU-VERB USAGE:
[object]をリサイクルする - to recycle [object]

RELATED TERMS:
- {分別|ぶんべつ} - sorting (of garbage)
- {再利用|さいりよう} - reuse
- エコ - eco (ecological)
- {廃棄物|はいきぶつ} - waste

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has extensive recycling programs. Many municipalities require residents to sort garbage into detailed categories, and リサイクルショップ (secondhand shops) are common.
